function: Channel reconstruction: synthesizes the OFDM sensing channel from target EM property and location; the reverse direction senses EM property from the estimated channel (p. 2, 10).
system: Monostatic ISAC BS: 32 transmit and 32 receive antennas, fully digital; OFDM with 16 subcarriers at 30 GHz; one target at a time; no RIS (p. 2, 8-9).
method: Diffusion Schrödinger bridge (forward and backward NNs trained alternately by IPF, flow-matching initialization) plus convolutional autoencoder with positional embedding; generative training on simulated target-channel pairs (p. 5-8).
data_channel: 100,000 ShapeNet targets at random positions in a 30 m sector (80/10/10 split); echo channels from own EM simulation (MoM with BCGS-FFT) (p. 9).
test_conditions: Training and testing targets share one distribution: ShapeNet shapes randomly placed in the same sector; results versus SNR and target location; no unseen scenario (p. 9-10).
baselines: none reported; results show only the proposed DSB at three target locations; LS only estimates the sensing channel for input (p. 3, 9-10).
metrics: Mean Chamfer distance (MCD, dB) of the reconstructed 5D point cloud for EM property sensing; NMSE of the reconstructed channel (p. 8-10).
complexity: none: only a qualitative remark that the simplified loss reduces complexity (p. 7); no FLOPs, parameter count, or runtime.
q1_support: p. 9: "In order to compute the forward scattering, we convert (9) into a discrete form by the methods of moments (MoM)"; channels come from the paper's own EM simulation, not 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data
q2_support: p. 9: "we select 100000 targets from the ShapeNet dataset [40], which are split into training, testing, and validation sets by the ratio 80%, 10%, and 10%, respectively"; held-out part of the same data, with all targets randomly located in the same sector
q3_support: p. 10: "We explore the MCD of the reconstructed 5D point clouds versus SNR in Fig. 5"; Figs. 4-9 show only the proposed DSB at several SNRs and target locations, with no classical or learned comparison method
q4_support: p. 7: "To reduce the complexity, the training loss associated with DSB can be simplified as"; qualitative only, with no FLOPs, parameter count, order of complexity or runtime reported
q5_support: p. 9: "we select 100000 targets from the ShapeNet dataset [40]"; ShapeNet gives only 3D shapes, the channels come from the own EM simulation, and no link to code or data is given
notes: Version read: arXiv v1 preprint (18 Sep 2024), 13 pages. Borderline on function, for the reviewer: the method has two functions, EM property sensing (sensing, not one of the seven areas) and channel reconstruction (synthesis of the monostatic echo channel, area 2). Area 5 rejected because no beams, waveforms or resources are designed. No communication link is modeled (monostatic echo, p. 2), so the reviewer may prefer exclusion under function. The conclusion claims superiority (p. 10-11) but no baseline is reported.
